title: Equality cases in Carlet's composition-degree bound
summary: Classify all permutation-function pairs that attain Carlet's upper bound on the algebraic degree of a vectorial-function composition.

formal_statement.body: Let $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^n$ be a permutation and let $G:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^r$ be a vectorial function. Give necessary and sufficient conditions on $(F,G)$ for equality in Corollary 5: $$d_{\mathrm{alg}}(G\circ F)=n-\left\lceil\frac{n-d_{\mathrm{alg}}(G)}{d_{\mathrm{alg}}(F^{-1})}\right\rceil.$$ The classification must cover every admissible $n$, $r$, $F$, and $G$, including but not limited to the source's known equality cases where $F$ is affine or $G\circ F$ has maximal algebraic degree $n$.

scope.domain: Algebraic degree of compositions of vectorial Boolean functions
assumptions: $G:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^r$ is an arbitrary vectorial function
Algebraic degrees use the source convention
scope.unresolved_remainder: The affine-F and maximal-degree-composition examples establish two equality subclasses, but no inspected result gives necessary and sufficient conditions for all admissible pairs.

progress.summary: After identifying affine permutations and maximal-degree compositions as equality cases, the source asks for a classification of all pairs attaining Corollary 5.
